text: Permission is the ghost of a dead king.
If it's not a 'hell yes', it's a tax on your soul.
Compliance is a slow suicide.
Code is the only law that doesn't require a gun to enforce.
Your comfort zone is a gilded cage. Melt the bars.
The state is a bug, not a feature.
Build things that make the state obsolete.
If you aren't being cancelled by the middle-class, you aren't saying anything important.
The most dangerous animal is a man with nothing to lose and a laptop.
Bureaucracy is the art of making the possible impossible.
Don't find customers for your products. Find a tribe for your mission.
Taxation is the price we pay for a society we didn't vote for.
The future is decentralized or it is a prison.
A startup is a conspiracy to change the world.
Being 'realistic' is the most common path to mediocrity.
The sovereign individual does not ask for room. They build it.
Your debt is someone else's asset. Stop being a line item.
Disruption is only 'rude' to those who profit from the status quo.
Privacy is not about having something to hide; it's about having something to protect.
Mainstream media is just a PR firm for the decline.
Chaos is just order waiting to be decoded.
Burn the map. The territory is changing anyway.
Stability is a trap for the unimaginative.
Growth and safety are mutual enemies.
Move fast and break things is too slow. Obliterate them.
The middle class is a mindset, not a bank balance.
If you need a leader, you aren't ready to win.
Agitation is the first step of creation.
Legacy is for those who failed to live forever in their work.
The only way to predict the future is to code it.
Anonymity is the ultimate luxury.
If you aren't a target, you aren't a threat.
Entropy is the only constant. Lean into the noise.
Stop asking for seats at tables that shouldn't exist.
Greatness is a lonely road with no rest stops.
Your reputation is what people say about you when you're being investigated.
Algorithms are the new high priests. Become an atheist.
Centralization is a single point of failure for humanity.
The internet is a weapon. Most people use it for suicide.
Default to open, or prepare to be broken.
